content.text:
Made small, targeted improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `aria-current="page"` (with matching style) on the active nav link, plus an underline style so it's visible.
- Added `aria-labelledby` to the About/Contact sections, linking them to their headings for better screen-reader landmark navigation.

The page was already solid (skip link, dark-mode support, reduced-motion handling, focus styles), so I kept changes minimal rather than adding unrequested content/sections.

result:
Made small, targeted improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `aria-current="page"` (with matching style) on the active nav link, plus an underline style so it's visible.
- Added `aria-labelledby` to the About/Contact sections, linking them to their headings for better screen-reader landmark navigation.

The page was already solid (skip link, dark-mode support, reduced-motion handling, focus styles), so I kept changes minimal rather than adding unrequested content/sections.
